text: page is one 64-token KV page. The PR adds two state members to it (k_rows_saved_, k_vnni_blocks_) that record, per storage slot, which K rows are saved and which 16-token blocks hold the VNNI layout.

fields.name: page
fields.type_or_shape: struct page<n_layers, n_kv_heads, head_size, x_bytes, layout_t>; page_size == k_vnni::PAGE_TOKENS_64 (64 tokens)
fields.one_line: The K layout state of Note [K VNNI storage]: k_rows_saved_ holds one bit per page offset and storage slot, k_vnni_blocks_ one bit per 16-token block and storage slot.

text: detail::kv_block is the KV cache for one KV head in one KV slot of one page: one K plane (k) and one V plane (v). The PR changes the type of k to k_storage (below); v is unchanged.

fields.name: detail::kv_block<page_size, head_size>
fields.container: book kv_block arena (one per (slot, kv_head, page))
fields.type_or_shape: struct alignas(kv_block_alignment) kv_block { alignas(kv_block_alignment) k_storage k; alignas(kv_block_alignment) v_storage v; }; sizeof(k) == sizeof(v)
fields.one_line: One kv_block is the KV cache for one KV head in one KV slot; it stores the {k,v} data contiguously to make prefetching easier.

text: kv_block::k_storage is the type of kv_block::k: the typed owner k_vnni_tensor for a VNNI slot, a plain bf16 array for a row-major slot. Both hold page_size * head_size bf16, and a static_assert pins the equal size.

fields.name: kv_block::k_storage (the type of kv_block::k)
fields.one_line: Packed K (TRON_K_VNNI, 128-dimension heads): k is the typed owner k_vnni_tensor of Note [K VNNI storage]. Both hold page_size * head_size bf16 values.

text: page::k_rows_saved_ is the saved-row bit set: one 64-bit word per storage slot, one bit per page offset. Bits are set by save_k and the full-block save, dropped by clear_kv_complete_at, and carried by page copies.

fields.name: page::k_rows_saved_
fields.one_line: K rows saved, one bit per page offset, per storage slot (entry layout_t::n_slots = the EAGLE storage), VNNI slots only; a block whose 16 bits are set is complete and is queued for its conversion.

text: page::k_vnni_blocks_ is the converted-block bit set: one byte per storage slot, one bit per 16-token block. A set bit implies the block's 16 row bits in k_rows_saved_.

fields.name: page::k_vnni_blocks_
fields.one_line: Converted 16-token blocks, one bit per block, per storage slot (the same entries). Set by the forward-end conversion and the full-block save, dropped by clear_kv_complete_at; a set bit implies the block's 16 row bits.

text: page::EAGLE_STORAGE_SLOTS_1 is the one extra state entry beyond the logical slots. Entry layout_t::n_slots of both bit arrays belongs to the EAGLE storage.

fields.name: page::EAGLE_STORAGE_SLOTS_1
fields.one_line: One state entry beyond the logical slots: the EAGLE storage.

text: The plane is K for one KV head of one page: 64 tokens x 128 dimensions of bf16 = 16 KiB, the same bytes as the row-major plane in a different order. Its index formula is plane[(((s * 4 + c) * 16 + dp) * 16 + t) * 2 + j] == K[c * 16 + t][s * 32 + 2 * dp + j], with s the dimension step, c the token block, dp the dimension pair and t the token.

fields.name: plane (the K VNNI plane)
fields.type_or_shape: 64 tokens x 128 dimensions of bf16 = 16 KiB; indexed by (s, c, dp, t, j)
fields.one_line: Plane layout (64 tokens x 128 dimensions of bf16 = 16 KiB, the same bytes as the row-major plane), indexed by dimension step s (32 dimensions), token block c (16 tokens), dimension pair dp and token t.

text: A panel is one (s, c) cell of the plane: 16 dimension-pair rows of 64 bytes = 1 KiB (PANEL_BYTES_1024). A panel is exactly one AMX B tile.

fields.name: panel (s, c)
fields.type_or_shape: STEP_PAIRS_16 pair rows x LINE_BYTES_64 bytes = PANEL_BYTES_1024 (PANEL_ELEMS_512 bf16, PANEL_DWORDS_256 dwords)
fields.one_line: One (s, c) is one 1 KiB panel: 16 dimension-pair rows of 64 bytes. A panel is exactly one AMX B tile.

text: A row-major block is the other form of the same 4 KiB: until all 16 of its K rows are saved, token t of block c owns 256 contiguous bytes (its 128 bf16 in dimension order) at row_major_row(). Panel (t / 4, c) holds the rows of tokens 4 (t / 4) .. 4 (t / 4) + 3, 256 bytes each, and no other block is touched by either layout.

fields.name: row-major block (Note [Row-major tail block])
fields.container: plane (the same 4 KiB as the VNNI block c)
fields.type_or_shape: 4 panels x PANEL_ROWS_4 token rows of 256 bytes (HEAD_SIZE_128 bf16 in dimension order)
fields.one_line: A 16-token block of the plane holds the VNNI layout only once all 16 of its K rows are saved. Until then the block holds its rows row-major: token t of block c owns 256 contiguous bytes at row_major_row().

text: The row and panel size constants of namespace k_vnni: ROW_ELEMS_32, ROW_DWORDS_16, PANEL_ELEMS_512, PANEL_BYTES_1024, PANEL_DWORDS_256, N_PANELS_16 (= DIM_STEPS_4 * TOKEN_BLOCKS_4), LANES_16 and PANEL_ROWS_4 (= PANEL_ELEMS_512 / HEAD_SIZE_128). N_PANELS_16 * PANEL_ELEMS_512 == PAGE_TOKENS_64 * HEAD_SIZE_128 by static_assert: the VNNI plane is a permutation of the row-major plane.

fields.name: ROW_ELEMS_32, ROW_DWORDS_16, PANEL_ELEMS_512, PANEL_BYTES_1024, PANEL_DWORDS_256, N_PANELS_16, LANES_16, PANEL_ROWS_4
fields.one_line: One pair row = one 64-byte line = 32 bf16 = 16 dwords. One panel = 16 dimension-pair rows x 16 tokens x 2 paired values (1 KiB). A row-major block keeps 4 token rows of 256 bytes in each of its 4 panels.

text: FULL_BLOCK_0XFFFF is the 16-lane mask with every token of a block present. It is the `present` argument of store_block for a whole-block save and the bit pattern of k_block_bits(c) in the page.

fields.name: FULL_BLOCK_0XFFFF
fields.one_line: The 16 lanes of one token block, all present.

text: BLOCKS_PER_PAGE_MASK_0XF is the block mask with all 4 blocks of a page set. A static_assert pins it to block_bit(TOKEN_BLOCKS_4) - 1, and the dense AMX gate compares page::k_vnni_blocks against it.

fields.name: BLOCKS_PER_PAGE_MASK_0XF
fields.type_or_shape: inline constexpr uint8_t = 0xfu (static_assert at k_vnni.hpp:112-113: one bit per token block)
fields.one_line: The 4 token blocks of a page, one bit each (page::k_vnni_blocks). A block mask equal to it has every block of the page set.

text: block_bit(c) and offset_bit(offset) name the two bit sets the page keeps: bit c of a block mask (page::k_vnni_blocks) is token block c, and bit `offset` of a page-offset mask (the saved rows of a page) is the row at that page offset.

fields.name: block_bit(c), offset_bit(offset)
fields.type_or_shape: constexpr uint8_t block_bit(size_t c) = 1u << c; constexpr uint64_t offset_bit(size_t offset) = uint64_t{1} << offset
fields.one_line: Bit c of a block mask (page::k_vnni_blocks): token block c of the page. Bit `offset` of a page-offset mask (the saved rows of a page): the row at that page offset.

text: BF16_BITS_16 and HIGH_HALF_0XFFFF0000 describe one dword of a pair row for the float query path of the reader: the even value sits in the low half (shift up 16 bits gives the exact fp32), the odd value in the high half (mask 0xffff0000 gives it as an fp32 bit pattern).

fields.name: BF16_BITS_16, HIGH_HALF_0XFFFF0000
fields.type_or_shape: inline constexpr int = 16; inline constexpr uint32_t = 0xffff0000u
fields.one_line: Width of a bf16: a bf16 shifted up by this many bits is the exact fp32. The high half of a dword: the odd value of a dimension pair as an fp32 bit pattern.

text: layout_on<head_size> is the layout gate: true for 128-dimension heads when TRON_K_VNNI is defined, false otherwise. It is a property of the storage geometry, so every reader and writer of a slot sees the same layout.

fields.name: k_vnni::layout_on<head_size>
fields.type_or_shape: template <size_t head_size> inline constexpr bool (= head_size == HEAD_SIZE_128 under #ifdef TRON_K_VNNI, else false)
fields.one_line: The layout gate. TRON_K_VNNI (CMake option) switches the K plane of every 128-dimension head to the VNNI layout. Every other head size keeps the row-major plane.
